existing_cleanup_primitives.authority: SignerAuthorityRevision next revision DISABLED with exact supersedes/predecessor via PostgresApprovalGovernance.appendSignerAuthorityRevision
existing_cleanup_primitives.key: SignerKeyRevision next revision RETIRED with exact previous lineage and revision via appendSignerKeyRevision

authority_expiry_is_not_cleanup: validUntil denies new verification after expiry; it does not append DISABLED or RETIRED. Key has no validUntil. Neither finite expiry nor finally proves post-crash cleanup.
replay_policy: Permanent binding/plan tombstones; no rebind/UPSERT. Retry exact same governance operation only under canonical immutable receipt contract. Duplicate registration rejected; lost COMMIT ack reconciled read-only. No fresh manifest/binding/correlation/decision allocation until proven failed root retired, and no expired signature/retired key reuse.
